title: Research: extend R439 frame obstruction to dirty workspace
body:
The fixed R439 B-block interfaces explicitly left added wires outside their obstruction. This package proves that independent dirty workspace cannot lower their original-wire frame invoice, even with arbitrary reversible nonlinear Boolean gates and arbitrary auxiliary garbage at exit. All 114 original exits still equal their rank-four block frames; the exact minimum is **93H2 + 10H3** (rank mass 216).

The proof extends the credited forward/inverse dependency invariant to essential dependence of bijections. For an endpoint (x,z) -> (Mx,G(x,z)), the inverse original coordinates remain M^-1 y for every workspace output. Exact rational span witnesses instantiate the result on all ten source-pinned blocks. The written induction covers arbitrary finite circuit lengths and workspace sizes; finite checks corroborate it.

**Scope:** independent arbitrary inputs; exact original block maps and entry labels; all operands share a monotone frame inside the block frame; fixed outside visits. Every auxiliary climb and continuation is charged. The complete frame-moment comparison keeps caller width, role denominator W and other charges fixed. Changed W, hosting, precision or cross-block entry contracts require separate pricing. No new κ, supplier adoption or selected-frontier change.

**Credit and delta:** PR1368 supplies the ten interfaces and forward witnesses. PR1511 already closes B508 by the XOR inverse-column invariant; PR1535/1576 close B509, with PR1778 later corroborating B508. PR1128 already allows restored dirty extras in its linear helper-boundary theorem. This adds the nonlinear/garbage-workspace closure and exact ten-block application, not priority for those results. The fixed-prefix nonlinear cleanup and PR1757 common-flag bounds are separately credited. Exact predecessor heads, licenses and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance are recorded. No subagents or independent human review.

Validation:
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes: both engines with isolated, optimized Python; seven test groups.
- Separate truth-table/permutation and integer-geometry oracle: 61,440 block inputs; 122,880 dirty-workspace inputs; 228 Gram witnesses; 362,880 nonlinear prefix/gate pairs; 1,536 garbage-fiber bijections.
- Both engines reject six actual certificate corruptions and changed source bytes. Semantic controls cover clean-only success, nonlinear one-hot false positives, illegal frame rules and noninvertible resets.
- Source pins, read-only relocation, selected-record integrity and staged whitespace checks pass. Both mathematical engines pass on an exact committed Git export of HEAD.
- Full selected cold replay, native/physical COPY/ERASE, hosting, H2/K adoption, all-size/compiler, precision/tape, analytic transfer and formal proof-assistant review remain unrun or inherited. Hosted CI is separate.

Reproduce:

    python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-dirty-workspace-frame-bound
